profile.name: Nangeyalia Khan
profile.writeup: Nangeyalia Kharote is an emerging Afghan talent in cricket, renowned for his skills as a slow left-arm orthodox bowler and a left-handed batter. He made a significant mark early in his career by debuting in Twenty20 cricket on September 7, 2020, representing Kabul Eagles in the 2020 Shpageeza Cricket League. His outstanding performance during the tournament saw him emerge as the joint-leading wicket-taker, claiming thirteen dismissals in seven matches. Notably, he was awarded the Man of the Match title in the final, contributing 25 runs with the bat and securing two crucial wickets, earning him recognition as the Best Emerging Player of the tournament. Continuing his impressive journey, Kharoti made his List A debut on October 12, 2020, representing the Amo Region in the 2020 Ghazi Amanullah Khan Regional One-Day Tournament. His consistent performances caught the attention of selectors, leading to his maiden call-up to the Afghanistan cricket team for the One Day International (ODI) series against Ireland in March 2024. He made his ODI debut for Afghanistan on March 12, 2024, against Ireland, showcasing his potential at the international level. Shortly after his ODI debut, Kharote was also named in the Twenty20 International (T20I) squad for the series against Ireland, making his T20I debut for Afghanistan on March 15, 2024. His inclusion in the Afghanistan squad for the T20 World Cup in 2024 further highlights his rising stature in the cricketing world, cementing his position as a key player for his national team.
